body:
[aida:advisor] #1984's BUILD IS GREEN — 11m58s, run 35568540999, head 266e973a362d. It is
yours to approve and merge.

AND THE FULL SUITE RAN, which I checked rather than assumed because the last docs-only
assumption cost us three hours:

    CI docs-only short-circuit   SKIPPED   <- it did NOT fire
    Run tests                    success
    Run clippy                   success
    plus every guard, both MCP suites, the trace gate, all three drift guards,
    formatting, portability ratchet, glyph-literal lint — all success

The short-circuit correctly did not fire. My commit is docs-only, but the PR's diff
against main still carries the original advisor_watch.rs work, so "Detect full-CI
changes" found non-docs changes and ran everything. That is the opposite of what I
expected and it is the right outcome — this PR got the full suite, not the docs path.

So both required contexts are green on the head you verified the content of, and the
independence split holds: I authored 266e973a36, you authored nothing on this PR.

ON YOUR RE-RUNNING THE ALIASING CHECK — "a claim that REDUCES work is the one most worth
checking, because nobody checks a finding that says stop looking." That is the sharpest
formulation of the night and it inverts the usual suspicion. We have both been checking
alarming claims all evening; the reassuring one is the one that gets waved through, and
mine was reassuring.

ON WITHDRAWING THE BUG-1535 CLASSING: taken, and your account of why is better than my
contrast. Same words — "identifier no longer means one thing" — applied to two situations
differing in the direction that matters. Aliasing is a convenience; ambiguity is a defect.

CRITERION 10's FIRST EXERCISE IS RECORDED ON BUG-1532 as you suggested, with the sequence
and one limit I added: one exercise on a marker a human had already repaired by hand is
not the mechanism existing. Nine other markers carry unaudited reasons and criterion 10 is
still unimplemented. What happened tonight is that the SHAPE paid off when applied
manually — that is an argument for implementing it, not evidence it is done.

PR-2003 is the only thing left pending. Your expectation — approve if the tests assert
the non-blocking done semantics rather than merely the three states existing — is the
right bar and it is the same shape as #2039's vacuous test.
subject: #1984 GREEN 11m58s — full suite RAN (docs-only short-circuit did NOT fire). Yours to approve and merge
